content: Amitu Tashi
Ingiese soyuji doghunni, piendaku, jiazhon gieku, dubilieku, sugieku enelai ta man widagha.
Yeliwa neizii neiiku mutun taye qingiezhi zhenni, pse gou daolini neii. Ruhherni ganjin neizii neii. Daolide kouizhi izhi fugiedase jiuine.
Ta Ezhan gou bikui mejiese qingiezhi gie.
Ta Ersai shida ire. Hheshi amitu tashi wo. Kunla hhei bendawoma, Huda hhazeliezhi sunghuwo.
Taye amitu tashi mutun nienieji luizhi ruhhertu gie gholu. Ingie zhiguitu buwa danladene Ersa Mexihai tungo giezhi Huda bayasuku mutun jiomuntu mure ogi.
Jinwun jiere kieliezho,

content.text: "Uzhe, bi zhiguide sunghusan tashii Xiwunde teizhi
Hhei xianxin giesanla jiuren ulie giene."

content: Ingiese ene tashi xianxin giesan tande zhigui woma, ulie xianxin giesan kunlade,
pse
Hhela banjikushi kielienyi uye shunjizho. Eneshi hhelai amin wo.
Ingieliuzhe tashi sunghusan bexin, honshan mutun buwa, zhiguitu minzu, bexin wo. Tai kharanise uruzhi khizheghadene goyai ghudureqitu gonqi dunda ireghasan Hudai famatuni kunlade kielieghane giezho.
Melieshida tashi bexin pusho. Ede Hudai bexin wo. Melieshida tande ubali ese xiizho. Ede ubali xiizho.
Mii orentula, tashi duyade zhanshi jiere sousan niman kun wo. Bi tande goude fenfulaye, ruhherghala eghinduku beyeni nefuxinni bu gie.
Ta niman kunlai dunda goude gie. Ingiese ta doghunni giezho giezhi sugiesan kunla ta goude giesei uzhedene Huda panjiku udude hhei kuaine.
Qienli Bareisan Kunlai Shunji
Ta Ezhanyi yenyinghala soyuji kunni zhiduni shunji. Zui fugie qienlitu honshan,
pse noyenlai shunji. Noyenlashi doghunni giesan kunlai faizhi gounii giesan kunlai kuaighane giezhi honshan peisan wo.
Hudai isishi ta gouni giezhi bende yama ulie mejiechen kunlai amanyi duigha giezho.
Tashi ziyutui woma, ziyughala doghunni gieku jiekou bu gholughadene Hudai hoji mutun gie.
Jien kunlai zunzhun gie. Xianxin giesan kunlade ore. Hudai zunji. Honshanyi zunzhun gie.
Mexiha Shouku Giezhi Yanzi Uzheghazho
Hoji danlasan kunla, ta zunzhun gieku zhugheghala ezhanne shunji. Zinie gou, renyitui pusho, mouxiennilaiye shunji.
Kien hanhanji shouku giedene Hudai sumulazhi rennai giese kuaikui wine.
Zui fanjidene eghikui rennai giese yan kuaikui wine? Gouni giedene shouku giekui rennai giese Hudai melie kuaikui wine.
Shouku gieliuzhe gouni giekude Huda tai uruzho. Mexihaye tande oluzhi shouku giezhi yanzi uzheghawo. Tai goyane korolon mutun yoghane giezho.
Hhei sugiekude khareizhi ese sugiewo, shouku giekude ayighaku kielien ese kieliewo, khareidene goyane gundande panjichen Hudade jiuiwo.
Hhe qinsi beyeghalane shizijia jiere mai zuini danjidene mai zui dunda udu ulie daoghazhi gounide udu daoghawo. Hhe shan deiladene ta goudawo.
Ta eqighandei miisan ghoni niekielien wo. Ede ruhhertai adulachen, baohu giechen hhei shida khareizhi irewo.
